Welcome to Tom Brolley’s Best Bets: 2026 NFL Draft Props edition. This will be the main hub for my favorite bets for the 2026 NFL Draft being held in Pittsburgh. The __Las Vegas Raiders__ will get the draft started with the first overall pick on Thursday, April 23, and the __Denver Broncos__ will finish the draft with the 257th overall pick on Saturday, April 25. Be sure to check back often before the start of the draft and during the draft to see what bets I like the most for the seven-round event.

\>Check out my [NFL Betting Mock Drafts](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/series/2026/best-bets#/) for comprehensive breakdowns of all my bets and much more. Catch up on all of my 2026 NFL Futures [articles](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/series/2026/best-bets#/) and [wagers](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/brolleys-best-bets-nfl-futures). Subscribe to the Best Bets Podcast on your [favorite platform](https://www.fantasypoints.com/media/podcasts/show/nfl-best-bets) and on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@FantasyPointsBetting) for year-round NFL betting talk…Join our “#official-bets” [Fantasy Points Discord](https://www.fantasypoints.com/media/discord) to see our staff's wagers as soon as we make them!
